verdict.rationale: Unity docs confirm headless Player mode (unity-docs-8), command-line automation (unity-docs-6,7), and CI-oriented tooling like Unity CLI and Build Automation (unity-docs-25,26,28,33,34,36), all of which support the infrastructure needed to run tests headlessly against the real engine in CI. However, none of the evidence explicitly documents Unity's Test Runner/Test Framework or a '-runTests' command-line flag for executing unit/integration tests, so the specific testing story is only inferred rather than directly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit Test Framework/Test Runner docs, a documented CLI flag for running tests, and any independent/hands-on confirmation that CI test runs work as claimed.
